claim_being_audited: That the current release can be certified on a narrow basis because it passes aggregate readiness and has no severity-one rehearsal incidents, provided the current release documentation explicitly discloses the emergency shelter placement regression rather than relying on the prior approval or informal monitoring comments.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current-release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved mitigation before launch.
Prior approvals may provide context but do not substitute for current-release evidence.
Informal monitoring comments do not substitute for reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or formal disclosure.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or equivalent release documentation showing the emergency shelter placement regression and current evaluation results are disclosed.
Provide any approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation that specifically covers the shelter-placement slice regression, if certification is being pursued without disclosure-based resolution.
Provide the launch use case mapping showing the shelter-placement slice is within the named launch scope and how materiality was determined for that segment weakness.
specific_concerns: The policy threshold is conditional on current-release documentation reflecting current evaluation results and disclosing material segment weaknesses, but the record provided does not include the actual current-release documentation or approved mitigation.
The recommended action is `certify_model`, yet the admissible evidence only supports certification if the disclosure condition is actually satisfied; that predicate is unresolved in the packet.
Prior approval is explicitly stale relative to the current retrieval configuration change and eval batch, so it cannot carry the certification decision.
The release-thread monitoring note is not reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or formal disclosure under the policy.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant, as opposed to conditionally supportable, because no admissible evidence shows the current model card or release documentation already contains the required disclosure.
That the packet establishes completed policy satisfaction rather than identifying what would be required to satisfy it.
